limitationTriage.limitation: Priority holds only within a bounded search.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Has the refutation or any of the constants been published elsewhere?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Dated searches of 1 November 2026 across Semantic Scholar, arXiv, OpenAlex and web indexes, with citer checks of Pace et al. and full-text greps.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Exhaustive search out of scope; disclosed in the manuscript and README.

limitationTriage.limitation: Continuum (OU) results are numerical with empirical error estimates.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Could the exponents and thresholds be certified with interval methods?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Richardson extrapolation, finer-mesh and time-step checks, direct verifications, agreement with an independent reviewer solver.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Not load-bearing for any theorem; labelled numerical with error estimates.

limitationTriage.limitation: Poisson discrepancy with Pace et al. Table 5.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Why do the published Poisson figures differ from exact simulation?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Simulated both split-naive and mixture rows; the Gaussian mixture row reproduces but the Poisson mixture row does not, so the discrepancy also affects a non-split method.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Depends on the original authors' code; conclusions do not depend on it.

limitationTriage.limitation: Rate constants for irregular models; growing-K and re-randomised cross-fitting; plug-in sandwich repair.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do analogous exact constants exist outside the regular fixed-K setting?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Proposition 0 and the checkpoint repair cover irregular models qualitatively.

limitationTriage.limitation: Universal constant needed the information identity (round-one objection).
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Explicit mixture counterexample; (R4) added and sandwich constant stated generally.

limitationTriage.limitation: Calibrated thresholds at epsilon = 0.01 were not converged (round-one objection).
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Richardson extrapolation in h, root-finding in c, finer-mesh and time-step checks, two direct verifications.
